I am seeking detailed conversation on how to survive if humanity is thrown back into the stone age (metaphorically speaking).

I envision two scenarios:

Scenario #1 - You still have access to other modern supplies and technology like bicycles, non-computerized machinery, solar power, etc.

Scenario #2 - You are in the middle of no where with only what you have in your vehicle/home.
A massive EM Pulse wipes out all technology, cars, computers, internet and almost all power.....how do you survive?

For me I would:

Scenario #2: I drive a semi truck so chances are I would find myself in the middle of nowhere when it happened, that is the way my luck goes. So I would empty the electronics from my rolling laptop bag and pack whatever food and drinks I have into it. Grab a few extra pairs of socks and put on my hiking boots/shoes. Then I would grab my gun and ammo and head out walking towards the nearest body of water that leads to the ocean (or the ocean if close). I would seek a horse or three wheeled bicycle as soon as possible as I am fat and out of shape. Once I am no longer walking I would start scouring around on my trip to the coast for a working vehicle (old points fired motorcycle or car) that is still operable. As soon as I had a vehicle I would find a Camping/Survival Store and stock up on supplies including a pump to siphon fuel and haul ass to the Gulf Coast (where I currently live). Then I would transition to Scenario #1.

Scenario #1 - I am back home with an old but working vehicle. I start scouring around for welding equipment, sheet metal, etc. and gather up some help from others who share my ideas and build a massive floating city in the Gulf of Mexico near Mobile, AL. The city would be designed from the get go to be entirely wind/solar powered (technology that should still be operable or fixable) and would be completely self contained with it's own agricultural ecosystem as well as sewage treatment and salt water desalinization. Once the city was built I would use the massive electric-driven props built into the city to move the entire city (with population) into a more suitable area....IE Somewhere with a near constant climate/temperature and far away from land. I am thinking about a 10,000 person population in the city. It would have all the working technology we could scavenge like computers that had never been connected to any power source (ie - where still being assembled), sail boats and other water craft we could build/make work again.
